common_secret_will_clear: Will be removed when you save.
demo_badge_title: This demo runs in your browser. The data is fictional, nothing is sent anywhere, and your changes are forgotten when you reload.
demo_footer_text: You are using a demo that runs entirely in your browser, with fictional data.
files_chain_account_has_pst: The matching mailbox already has a PST, so it was left alone.
files_chain_already_assigned: This file is already assigned to a mailbox.
files_chain_ambiguous: Several mailboxes match this file name, so nothing was assigned.
files_chain_no_match: No mailbox matches this file name.
files_delete_text: Delete {name} from the server? Mailboxes linked to it will have no PST.
files_drop_sentence: Drop PST, OST, mbox, EML, MSG, ICS, VCF or ZIP files here. Interrupted uploads resume where they stopped.
files_fetch_failed: The download could not be started
files_fetch_filename_hint: Optional. By default the name comes from the address.
files_fetch_host_key_hint: Optional. Empty: the first key seen is remembered and then enforced.
files_fetch_sentence: The server downloads the file itself, so your computer can stay off. Passwords and keys are stored encrypted.
files_inbox_empty: Nothing is waiting in the folder.
files_inbox_sentence: Copy PST files here (rsync, scp, a mount). A file is taken once it has not changed for {seconds} s.
files_list_empty_text: Files appear here after upload, with what the analysis found in them.
files_list_incomplete: Upload not finished. Add the same file again to resume it.
files_list_load_failed: The file list could not be loaded
files_order_date_note: Browsers only expose the last modified date of a file, not the date it was created.
files_page_empty: No PST file on the server yet.
files_page_summary: Files on the server: {total}, valid: {valid}, total size: {size}.
files_queue_failed: Upload of {name} failed: {error}. You can resume it.
files_queue_reselect: The page was reloaded, so the browser no longer has these files. Select each one again and it resumes where it stopped.
jobs_action_retry_done: Job queued again. Items already imported are skipped.
jobs_errors_failed: The errors could not be loaded
jobs_errors_none: No item failed in this job.
jobs_log_failed: The log could not be loaded
jobs_report_failed: The report could not be loaded
jobs_report_missing_text: The report is written when the job finishes.
jobs_stop_text: The job stops cleanly. You can run it again later without creating duplicates.
login_form_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
migrations_account_login_hint: Leave empty to use the email address.
migrations_account_password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
migrations_account_save_failed: The mailbox could not be saved
migrations_bar_hidden: Hidden by the filter and left out of any action: {count}.
migrations_csv_columns: One mailbox per line, separated by a semicolon or a comma. The header and the login are optional.
migrations_csv_failed: The CSV file could not be imported
migrations_csv_title: Import mailboxes from a CSV file
migrations_delete_text: Delete {email}? Nothing changes on the mail server.
migrations_details_only_status: Only the overall status of this test was kept. Test again to see each protocol.
migrations_empty_no_account_text: Add mailboxes one by one or import a CSV file, then link a PST file to each.
migrations_empty_no_server_text: Mailboxes are imported into a server, so it comes first.
migrations_import_none: None of the selected mailboxes can start now.
migrations_import_no_pst: No valid PST file, will not start: {count}.
migrations_import_ready: Ready to start: {count}. Items already imported are skipped, so running it twice creates no duplicates.
migrations_page_load_failed: The mailboxes could not be loaded
migrations_page_worker_down: The worker is not responding, so queued imports will not start. Check the worker container.
migrations_route_resend: Pointing at another mailbox forgets what was already sent: everything will be sent again.
migrations_route_save_failed: The route could not be saved
migrations_route_source_pst_hint: Choose the file in the mailbox's panel.
migrations_route_target_server_hint: The usual case: items go to the server the mailbox belongs to.
migrations_route_unknown: This server no longer offers the connector {kind}. Choose another one.
migrations_row_upload_queued: File added to the upload queue. It is linked to this mailbox once the analysis finds it valid.
settings_appearance_mask_hint: For screenshots: shortens addresses, hosts and file names on screen.
settings_intake_chain_hint: A valid file named jane.doe@example.com.pst goes to the mailbox jane.doe@example.com. Only files analysed from now on are considered.
settings_intake_domains_hint: For files named without a domain: jane.doe.pst goes to jane.doe@ followed by the domain of that server.
settings_intake_inbox_hint: Mail, calendar and contact files and archives are taken, once they stop changing.
settings_intake_load_failed: The settings could not be loaded
settings_intake_sentence: Files copied into a folder on the server are picked up and analysed, and can be assigned to their mailbox on their own.
settings_intake_start_hint: Only when the mailbox has a password and no job running.
settings_notifications_enabled_hint: Be told when files are analysed and migrations finish, without watching the screen.
settings_notifications_ev_analysis_inval: A file was analysed and is invalid
settings_notifications_ev_analysis_valid: A file was analysed and is valid
settings_notifications_ev_repeated_crash: A migration crashed more than once
settings_notifications_mask_hint: Shows j***@e***.com instead of the real address, file names included.
settings_notifications_public_warning: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic name can read these messages. Use a long random topic, or your own ntfy server with an access token, and consider masking addresses.
settings_notifications_save_failed: The notification settings could not be saved
settings_notifications_sentence: Be told when files are analysed and migrations finish. Nothing is sent until you turn it on and enable a channel.
settings_password_done: Admin password changed. Other sessions are signed out.
settings_password_env: The password is set by ADMIN_PASSWORD. Change the variable and restart the container.
settings_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
settings_password_sentence: Changing it signs out every other session.
settings_server_builders_hint: Leave empty for the machine default.
settings_server_dav_hint: Leave empty for automatic discovery. Placeholders: {email}, {user}, {domain}.
settings_server_delete_text: Delete {name}? Its mailboxes are deleted too. Nothing changes on the mail server.
settings_server_root_hint: PST folders are created under this one. Empty means the root of the mailbox.
settings_server_save_failed: The server could not be saved
settings_servers_empty_text: Add the server your mailboxes are migrated to.
settings_servers_sentence: Where the mailboxes are migrated to.
settings_tuning_concurrency: Files uploaded at the same time
settings_tuning_concurrency_hint: The chunks of a file are always sent in parallel. One file at a time is the safe default.
settings_tuning_sentence: Import tuning is set per server. This one applies to this browser.
batch_stop_text: Every job of this batch that is queued, running or paused stops cleanly. You can run them again later without creating duplicates.
jobs_action_delta_done: Final resync queued. Only what arrived since the last pass is copied.
leftout_failed: The list could not be loaded
leftout_filtered: Items left out by a filter
leftout_oversized: Messages too large for the target
migrations_import_batch_hint: Optional. Jobs started together under a name can be followed and controlled as a group.
migrations_import_mode_delta: Final resync: only what arrived since
migrations_import_mode_hint: Some of these mailboxes already ran. Items already imported are skipped in both cases.
plan_running: Checking the mailboxes. Nothing is written to any target.
policy_effective: Applied to this mailbox, with the server rules
policy_exclude_hint: One per line. * and ? work, for example Junk*.
policy_hours_hint: Leave empty to allow any time. Jobs of this server wait outside these hours and start by themselves.
policy_load_failed: The rules could not be loaded
policy_rate_hint: Shared by the running jobs of this server. Empty means no limit.
settings_tokens_create_failed: The token could not be created
settings_tokens_load_failed: The tokens could not be loaded
settings_tokens_once: Copy this token now. It is shown only once.
settings_tokens_revoke_text: The token {name} stops working at once. Scripts that use it will be refused.
settings_tokens_sentence: For scripts and the mccb command. A token has the same rights as you, except that it cannot create or revoke tokens.
migrations_step_to_refused: The server refused this login. Check the password or the login, then test again.
migrations_start_need_source: Choose where the mail comes from first.
migrations_start_need_password: Add the password of the mailbox first.
migrations_start_ready: Ready. Items already copied are skipped, so starting twice creates no duplicates.
migrations_start_unchecked: The login has not been checked yet. It is checked again just before the start.
migrations_new_source_hint: A file already on the server, one to send now, or choose later.
migrations_new_email_hint: The mailbox on {server} that receives the mail.
migrations_new_password_hint: The password of this mailbox on the destination server. It is checked right after saving.
settings_server_provider_oauth: Microsoft refuses plain passwords over IMAP. To write into Microsoft 365, choose Exchange Online in each mailbox's Source and target.
settings_server_provider_app_password: {name} asks for an app password: create one in the account's security settings and use it as the mailbox password.
migrations_steps_server: Add the server the mail goes to
migrations_steps_server_hint: Gmail, Microsoft 365, iCloud, Fastmail, Infomaniak or any IMAP server. It is checked right after saving.
migrations_steps_new_hint: Where the mail comes from (a PST or another file, Exchange, Microsoft 365, Google, IMAP) and the mailbox it goes to. Many mailboxes at once: import a CSV file.
migrations_steps_start_hint: The mailbox's panel says what is still missing, then Start migration copies everything. Progress shows in the list.
